name: Avipattikar Powder 100gm – Control Acidity
original_description:
Avipattikar Powder 100gm – Control Acidity

Avipattikar Powder is an herbal mix enriched with Triphala, Trikatu, Trvrit (Nishottar) that may help to stimulate digestion and metabolism. It may soothe the stomach tissues and promote normal, comfortable levels of acidity during the digestive process. This cooling blend may help balance the digestive fire and eliminate natural toxins from the system. It may help control the formation of gas and the discomfort associated with it.

Benefits of Avipattikar Powder Control Acidity

  • May promote normal levels of acidity in the stomach and intestine.
  • May support healthy elimination.
  • May help eliminate natural toxins from the system
  • It may help control the formation of gas.

Direction for use: Take 3-5gms powder, 1 to 2 times a day
rewritten_description:
Avipattikar Powder is a traditional herbal blend featuring Triphala, Trikatu, and Trvrit (Nishottar). This unique combination of herbs is designed to support digestive well-being. The cooling properties of Avipattikar Powder may help balance the digestive system, while its natural ingredients may aid in maintaining a healthy stomach and intestine.

The traditional use of Avipattikar Powder is rooted in Ayurvedic principles, which emphasize the importance of a balanced digestive system for overall well-being. By incorporating Avipattikar Powder into your daily routine, you may experience a soothing and calming effect on the stomach tissues.

Direction for use: Take 3-5gms powder, 1 to 2 times a day
